identity: Ossuary Reach shelves and labels the Throng's bones; the Gravewood is waking around the archive and a skeleton calling itself the Marrow Archivist is re-filing the dead under its own name.

quests.title: A Second Readable Copy
quests.text: I copy the old labels before damp and time finish their work, but I am running short of sound boards. Bring me ten Gravewood Planks from the {name:bonewood} for new name boards. A name is easier to preserve while there is still somebody who can read it.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3.5's Paper replaced (check: papyrus grows only on warm shores): a local wood.

quests.title: Paper Remembers
quests.text: Mereth Rubbinghand at Boneledger Post keeps copies of the inscriptions we stand to lose. Go and speak to her about the work. Stone lasts a long time, but a second record has the advantage of surviving somewhere else.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Misfiled in a Wolf
quests.text: The Ash Howlers have been dragging labelled remains through the {name:bonewood}. Kill eight by day before more of my neighbours are scattered among their feeding places. I spent a long time putting those names beside the right people.
quests.lesson: A use at a place or a day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Dry Keeping for the Copies
quests.text: Every copy I make records which stone it came from; I would like that information to survive the next rain. Bring me three Chests for the records. There is a limit to what careful handwriting can do while floating.
quests.lesson: A later errand or use; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Filed Under Theft
quests.text: Skeleton Marrow Archivist stole my chisel and is using it to cut his own entries over old names in the {name:deepwood}. I know the uneven bite that tool leaves; I sharpened it for honest work. Kill him, {dir_from_giver:marrow_archivist}, and bring me word. He does not get to call theft an addition to the archive.
quests.completion: The Archivist can cut no more entries with my stolen tool. I will preserve the names we can still read and mark the damage plainly; I will not fill the gaps with guesses.
quests.lesson: The named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Ashveil Keeps Its Own Records
quests.text: Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise keeps track of people whose names are easily lost in the fighting. Go and offer her help. She listens carefully, even when the news would be easier to put aside.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The departure id stays; free from 28, it requires nothing.

quests.title: The Copy Between Them
quests.text: An old name record and a fresh claim against those names lie together at the {name:claim_rest} in the {name:barrowlands}. Secure the copied claim with its original evidence before weather or another hand spoils the comparison. Take your findings to Mereth Rubbinghand at Boneledger Post; she knows how these records were copied. I can see that someone has made use of them, but I will not guess whose hand it was.
quests.completion: This new claim repeats a correction made only in an official register copy; the original stone has no such correction. Whoever wrote it worked from that older copy, rather than reading the names afresh. The names record who these people were, and the new demand borrows that authority to pretend they owed something.
quests.lesson: Chapter 2 of the story arc (story, may chain).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. T2a (K1 A): requires T2; lane CAPITALS' T3 requires it and ossuary_rubbings_03.

quests.title: A Chisel Leaves Its Signature
quests.text: There are fresh cuts across old names, and Neris Fossilhand recognises the uneven bite of the chisel stolen from her dig. Speak to her at Memoryvein Dig about the damage and the missing tool. She knows how a working edge changes; an overwritten name deserves that much care before we decide what happened to it.

quests.lesson: A travel quest with two givers in one zone.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS: the id stays (round60-plan.md §3: lane CAPITALS' T3 requires it, its one Throng follow-up); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: Marks Beside the Promise
quests.text: The anthracite and garnet orders are settled; this delivery copy bears both the guild's register mark and the military supply office's. Take this delivery copy to Iven Lastshift at the Miner's Guild house in Nhal Veyr so The Oathdelvers can record it.
quests.completion: These paired marks identify The Oathdelvers and the military supply office in the same delivery record. Each entry has someone to answer for it. I will keep the copy with the names of those who confirmed it.
